svg.title: Where my pull requests landed
svg.desc: An isometric city with one building per repository and one floor per merged pull request, grouped into company districts. Microsoft: kiota 7, onnxscript 6, azure-sdk-for-js 2, debugpy 2, playwright 2, typespec 2, mssql-python 1, vscode-cmake-tools 1; Meta: lexical 12, stylex 4; AWS: sagemaker-python-sdk 2, mcp 1, mcp-proxy-for-aws 1; Cloudflare: workers-sdk 3; OpenAI: openai-agents-python 1, tart 1; Apple: coremltools 2; Google: apphosting-adapters 1; Hugging Face: accelerate 1; Tesla: fixed-containers 1.
